tour.welcomeTitle: Your project is ready. Let’s get started!
tour.welcomeDescription: Discover the essentials of your workspace, one step at a time. You can skip the tour whenever you like.
tour.replayHint: You can find this tour again in Help, at the bottom of your sidebar.

overview.title: Your project, at a glance
overview.description: Your workspace brings together your project information, progress and next steps. The Overview is your starting point whenever you return.

sections.title: A clear path for your project
sections.description: The side menu helps you move through your project, from the problem statement to your report and defense. Complete the available steps to unlock the next ones.

ai.title: Take your next step with AI
ai.description: Start with the recommended section on your Overview. Inside each section, AI can help you draft content. Review and adapt its suggestions before continuing.

credits.title: Keep an eye on your credits
credits.description: Click your credit balance in the top bar to open this wallet. See your daily and purchased credits, recent activity, and full history. Check the cost before starting an AI generation.

settings.title: Make this workspace yours
settings.description: Open your account menu to find settings, edit your project information, choose your language or theme, and manage account security. You can replay this tour from Help anytime.

tooltips.overview: Define the core premise, goals, and domain of your project.
tooltips.problemStatement: Clearly articulate the issue your project aims to solve.
tooltips.actors: Identify all users and systems interacting with your application.
tooltips.solutions: Outline the technical and functional solutions to the problem.
tooltips.functionalRequirements: Specify the exact behaviors and features the system must support.
tooltips.nonFunctionalRequirements: Define system attributes like performance, security, and scalability.
tooltips.backlog: Organize and prioritize all pending tasks and features.
tooltips.umlPreparation: Design the system architecture using Unified Modeling Language diagrams.
tooltips.reportStructure: Outline the chapters and sections of your final PFE report.
tooltips.reportBuilder: Draft and assemble the content for your final report.
tooltips.presentation: Prepare the slides and material for your project defense.
tooltips.pitch: Craft a concise and compelling summary of your project.
tooltips.jurySimulation: Simulate a real oral defense with AI jury members.

overview.label: Project Overview
overview.description: Define core premise, academic domain, goals, and team members.

problemStatement.label: Problem Statement
problemStatement.description: Articulate the exact problem, existing challenges, and objectives.

actors.label: Actors & Personas
actors.description: Map primary, secondary, and external systems interacting with the solution.

solutions.label: Existing Solutions (SOTA)
solutions.description: State-of-the-art comparative matrix of existing market alternatives.

functionalRequirements.label: Functional Requirements
functionalRequirements.description: Specify system behaviors (RF-01, RF-02...) and feature specifications.

nonFunctionalRequirements.label: Non-Functional Requirements
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Define system performance, security, availability, and ISO quality attributes.

backlog.label: Product Backlog
backlog.description: Sprint-ready user stories, story points, and priority backlog items.

uml.label: UML Architecture & Diagrams
uml.description: Generate and edit PlantUML Class, Sequence, and Use Case diagrams.

reportStructure.label: Report Structure (Thesis Outline)
reportStructure.description: Academic thesis table of contents compliant with university norms.

reportBuilder.label: Report Studio (Editor & Generator)
reportBuilder.description: Rich academic editor with Corrective RAG section generation.

presentation.label: Defense Slides & Presentation
presentation.description: Generate structured presentation slides and keynote bullet points.

pitch.label: Elevator Pitch & Timed Speech
pitch.description: Craft a high-impact 3-minute oral defense pitch script.

jurySimulation.label: Jury Q&A Simulation
jurySimulation.description: Simulate a live oral defense with adversarial AI academic jury members.

settings.label: Workspace Settings
settings.description: Configure project API keys, language, and workspace preferences.

account.label: Account Profile
account.description: Manage your user profile, avatar, and credentials.
